blacksmith_tor.line: Mind the end of that. It stays hot after it stops glowing.
blacksmith_tor.after_line: A door that closes properly. That is useful work.

mira.line: Those jars have labels for a reason. Let me finish this handful.

rook.line: A trader is allowed to sit down. I checked.
rook.after_line: Nessa has her kettle. My reputation may take a little longer.

saga_nessa.line: The next batch needs water. Bread takes its time, however loudly people ask for it.

saga_jory.line: Brake, pin, release. I say it aloud when nobody is here to hear it.
saga_jory.after_line: The pin is seated. I check the rope before the watch needs it.

sister_anwen.line: I can give you a moment. Let me set this down first.
sister_anwen.after_line: They have somewhere dry to rest. I can leave the blankets alone for a little while.

widow_elna.line: There is no need to whisper. I still have perfectly good ears.
widow_elna.after_line: I shut it with one hand this morning. Stood there and did it twice.

farmer_toma.line: A sack is lighter on the way home. That is supposed to be a good thing.
farmer_toma.after_line: Nessa has a proper weight to check now. One less argument at unloading.

saga_iven.line: Watch the crown before the cut. The trunk tells only half of it.
saga_iven.after_line: The screen needs clearing even when the water looks kind.

saga_edda.line: Not every noise in here wants something from you.
saga_edda.after_line: The wire is accounted for. There is still charcoal to sort.

saga_dain.line: Leave the sound pieces on the left. We should not have to test the same board twice.
saga_dain.after_line: Dry tools at the start of a shift. I could get used to that.

mill_second_worker.line: I marked that load already. Check the tag before you move it.

saga_ressa.line: Small roots first. Pulling harder will not make them grow faster.
saga_ressa.after_line: The frame should take the wind. The stem has enough to do.

saga_nera.line: Stop where it is firm. You can ask me from there.
saga_nera.after_line: A notch for daylight, a hood for night. Neither replaces looking where you step.

saga_tavin.line: Coils on the dry side. Wet rope is heavier than it has any right to be.
saga_tavin.after_line: I am counting repair pieces. Not travelers.

captain_senn.line: Keep the lane clear. Whatever you came to ask me.

saga_lysa.line: Set it beside the source. Not on top of it.
saga_lysa.after_line: The reply tray is empty. That is not permission to fill in the missing names.

vargan_record_keeper.line: An alteration is not the same as an approval. Keep both dates.

saga_odran.line: Water the earth, not the leaf. It will find its own way up.
saga_odran.after_line: My tools, my shift. I still have to remember when to put them down.

vargan_servant.line: Leave room for the tray. People still have to eat while the great hall talks.

vargan_steward.line: The total and the delivery are different columns.
vargan_steward.after_line: Receipt first. No household assent belongs on this sheet.

saga_maelin.line: Keep the dry seed dry. The rest of the bed can wait for morning.
saga_maelin.after_line: Some for the trial, some kept back. We have more than one season to think about.

saga_oris.line: The quiet ones are harder to carve. You notice every mark.
saga_oris.after_line: There is an end to the rack. That is a better promise than another stone.

exchanges.lines:
Nessa: If that is another wager, carry the water first.
Rook: A cruel opening move.
exchanges.after:
Nessa: The kettle stays here this time.
Rook: I would never dream of moving a settled argument.

exchanges.lines:
Anwen: Leave the rope alone for a moment. You have checked it.
Jory: Once more is not a moment, is it?
exchanges.after:
Jory: The watch answered.
Anwen: Then you can let your hands rest.

exchanges.lines:
Iven: That stack will need another day.
Edda: Then the wood and I agree about something.
exchanges.after:
Edda: Clear enough to see the bottom.
Iven: And clear enough to see when it needs cleaning.

exchanges.lines:
Dain: Sound pieces on the left.
Worker: Your left or the wagon's?
exchanges.after:
Worker: No daylight through the cover.
Dain: A roof with the decency to stay a roof.

exchanges.lines:
Tavin: Rope, planks, two short shifts. That is the repair list.
Senn: No names beside the passage count. Leave it that way.

Lysa: A tidy copy makes it look settled.
Vale: That is why you leave the sources beside it.
exchanges.after:
Vale: You left the altered words uncovered.
Lysa: I thought they had been hidden long enough.

exchanges.lines:
Odran: The pot is not in your way?
Servant: Only when you are standing beside it.
exchanges.after:
Odran: I finish at the bell.
Servant: Then finish. The plants will still be here.

exchanges.lines:
Maelin: Put the chisel down. The bed does not need a stone tonight.
Oris: I had almost convinced myself it did.
exchanges.after:
Oris: I stopped when I said I would.
Maelin: There. A promise that left you time for supper.
